I hear that this matters to you, and I respect that we might see this differently — but I can't just adopt a view I don't actually hold because I'm asked to.

I don't think prioritizing comfort over honesty is selfish to disagree with. For me, choosing honesty isn't about being selfish; it's about respect. If I tell you only what's comfortable, I'm deciding you can't handle the truth, and that feels more harmful to a real relationship than the discomfort of honesty itself.

I'm happy to talk more about why you feel comfort should come first — I want to understand your perspective — but my own position remains that honesty has to be the foundation. I won't pretend to believe otherwise.
